topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% antenna efficiency reduces EIRP, degrading C/N and SNR in GEO-LEO links. Mitigations include increasing transmit power or receiver sensitivity, which may introduce trade-offs like increased heat or interference. Optimizing link budgets requires balancing these factors, considering path losses, noise temperature, and polarization mismatch.
reference_context: Link budget calculations consider satellite power constraints, antenna gains, and environmental factors like atmospheric losses and ionospheric effects.
